subject: 2026 Annual Performance Review Notice
body:
Hello Zhang Xia:

The 2026 annual performance review will begin soon. Please complete your self-assessment by April 15.

Review process:
1. Employee self-assessment (April 1–15)
2. Supervisor evaluation (April 16–25)
3. Results confirmation (April 26–30)

If you have any questions, please contact the HR department.

Human Resources Department
April 2, 2026
